objective: Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.

description: I find myself in quite a pinch here, <name>.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.
Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
progress: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
completion: A job well done, <name>! I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor. But my patrons will be happy once again!
My wife is quite a seamstress. Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
